record.field: JavaScript: OWL components, field widget, client action
The festival opens today: show how full it is, and give the volunteers a welcome desk to check the attendees in.

field.name: description
field.p: The Festival Solidaire opens its doors today: 120 people registered for 150 seats. The organisers want to see at a glance how full the festival is, and the volunteers of the entrance need a simple screen to welcome the attendees.

div.p: Development challenge: JavaScript. The server side is ready: write the OWL components of the module trivia_festival. The TODOs of the code are numbered like the missions below, and give the details.

A reload of the page is enough after a change of JavaScript or of an OWL template; a new record (client action, menu) needs an update of the modules (make update). Then click Check: the tab Checker Report lists what is still missing.
A field widget festival_fill_gauge which shows the seats taken as a progress bar, green, orange then red, used on the form of the event.
💡 Odoo 20 uses OWL 3, while the documentation and the AI often show OWL 2: read the cheat sheet at the top of fill_gauge.js.
A client action festival_kiosk which lists the registrations, with a Check in button that calls the server, and a Welcome Desk menu.
Check 3 attendees in from your welcome desk.

ul.li: A counter of the attendees in the systray, the icons at the top right.
A search box in the welcome desk.
